engineeringSkip.reason: Localised slowed-time 'chronostasis fields' created by spinning ultra-dense matter have no basis in known physics — gravitational time dilation exists but cannot be engineered into controllable zones, so this is fiction rather than an emerging technology.

factCheck.reason: Gravitational time dilation is real, but no known physics lets you build a local zone where time is noticeably slowed — it would take matter so dense it would instantly collapse into a black hole, and the effect would still be far too weak for stasis or travel.
